INDUSTRIAL RELATIONS (BALUCHISTAN) RULES, 1973
INDUSTRIAL RELATIONS (BALUCHISTAN) RULES, 1973
(Baluchistan Gaz. Extr. December. 28, 1973,
pp 1‑37.)
[No. 1‑‑50/73‑Labour,
24th August 1973. Rules framed by the Governor of Baluchistan in exercise of
the powers conferred by section 66(2) of the Industrial Relations Ordinance,
1969 (Ordinance No. XXIII of 1969) in consultation with the Federal
Government.]
CHAPTER‑I
GENERAL
1. Short Title and Commencement.‑(1) These rules may be
called the Industrial Relations (Baluchistan) Rules, 1973.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Definitions.‑‑(1) In these rules unless there is
anything repugnant in the subject or context.
(a) "Ballot Officer"
means an officer appointed under Rule 18 ;
(b) "Federation" means
a federation of trade unions which a Registrar appointed by the Government is
empowered to register ;
(c) "Form" means a form
appended to these rules ;
(d) "Government" means
tine Government of Baluchistan ;
(e) "Ordinance" means
the Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969 (XXITI of 1969);
(f) "Poling Officer"
means an officer appointed under Rule 18 ;
(g) "Section" weans a
section of the Ordinance ;
(h) "Secret Ballot or
Ballot" means a secret ballot bold under section 22;
(i) "Trade Union" or
"Union" means trade union registered under section 18;
(j) "Voter" means a
person whose name is included in the list verified by the Registrar under sub‑section
(5) of section 22.
(2) All other words and
expressions used but not defined in these rules shall have the same meaning as
assigned to them in the Ordinance.
3. Application for registration.‑(1) An application for
registration of a trade union made under section 5 shall be made tit Form
"".
(2) An application for
registration of a federation of trade unions made under section 20 shall be
made in Form "B".
4. Maintenance of registers of members, account books, minutes book.
etc.‑‑(1) The application for the membership of trade union
shall be in Form C .
(2) Every registered trade union
shall maintain a register of members, in Form D" showing particulars of
subscriptions paid try each member.
(3) Every registered Federation
shall maintain a register in Form "E" showing all moneys received by
it.
(4) Every registered trade union
or registered federation shall maintain (an account book an Form "F"
showing its receipts and expenditure. The account book shall be bound register
and all pages shall be numbered serially.
(5) The minute book of a
registered trade union or registered federa tion shall be kept in a bound
register, whose every page shall be numbered serially and shall contain the
following information, namely. ‑
(a) date place and time at which
the meeting of the general body or the executive committee of the trade union
or federation of trade unions are held ;
(b) details of all points discussed
and all resolutions passed ;
(c) in the case of meetings of
the general body, the approximate number of workers who attended the meeting
and, in the case of meetings of the executive committee, the names and
signatures of the officers of the executive who attended the meeting.
(6) All minutes shall be
confirmed in the subsequent meeting after reading out loudly, and taking
consent of all members present.
(7) Every registered trade union
or registered federation shall issue printed receipts for all moneys received
and shall maintain printed receipt books, every page of which shall be numbered
serially, and an account of all such receipt books shall be maintained.
(8) All expenses to be incurred
by a trade union or federation of trade unions shall be supported by vouchers
in original.
